subject: Re: Billing contact transfer — portal opt-in and two-step invoice ack
messages:
From: Sasha Miller <sasha@britech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@britech.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: New PO + delivery preference question

Hi Monica,

We attached PO 98123 for the November usage. Quick question on how you want us to receive invoices going forward — our AP team prefers an emailed PDF copy to accounts-payable@britech.com, but our head of procurement would like us to take advantage of your billing portal for consolidated monthly statements.

What would you recommend for the smoothest payment flow? Also, can you confirm whether the invoice needs our VAT reg number on each line for EU tax reclaim? (We're in the US but sometimes bill through EU entities.)

Attached: Britech_PO_98123.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks,
Sasha Miller
Finance Ops, Britech Analytics
sasha@britech.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Miller <sasha@britech.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@britech.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New PO + delivery preference question

Hi Sasha — thanks for the PO and the context. Short answer: both are possible; long answer: I'd recommend a hybrid two-step approach so AP keeps their emailed copy while procurement gets portal-level consolidation. Proposed flow:

1) We send a PDF invoice to accounts-payable@britech.com within 24 hours of invoice generation.
2) We also enroll the billing contact in the Redwood Portal so procurement can see consolidated monthly statements and download XMLs if needed.
3) For VAT: we can include the VAT reg number on each invoice line if you provide the specific entity and VAT ID — let me know which legal entity (US or EU).

If that sounds good I'll trigger the portal enrollment and set the email copy as mandatory until the first consolidated statement is agreed on. Grace, can you confirm the portal enrollment step and whether we should enable monthly ZIP bundles for them?

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Ops — Billing
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood-invoice-sample.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New PO + delivery preference question

Monica / Jordan — quick internal note before I respond to Sasha. I'm fine with the hybrid flow; it's low friction and reduces AP pushback. Operational items:

- Portal enrollment: create a Billing Contact (Sasha) and mark accounts-payable@britech.com as an invoice copy recipient.
- Enable monthly ZIP bundle of PDFs + one CSV manifest for line-level reconciliation. That keeps procurement happy without changing APs processes.
- VAT handling: we need the legal entity that will be billed. If it's the EU entity we must include VAT ID on each invoice and set the tax code so collection is correct.

Jordan — can you pre-populate a one-off invoice template that includes the VAT line and confirm the SFTP fallback if their mail filters block large ZIPs? I'll send the portal invite after Monica confirms wording for the enrollment email.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sasha Miller <sasha@britech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@britech.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New PO + delivery preference question

Thanks — that sounds perfect. Confirming:

- Britech will opt into the portal for consolidated monthly statements (procurement side).
- AP needs a PDF copy sent to accounts-payable@britech.com per invoice.
- VAT: please bill our EU entity (Britech EU GmbH) for cross-border work and add the VAT reg number (DE123456789) on each invoice line.

If you can enroll Sasha (me) as the Billing Contact, and keep the email delivery as a copy, we can move forward. Also, please enable the monthly ZIP bundle — procurement wants a single package for month-end.

I'll watch for the portal invite and the first emailed invoice.

— Sasha
Sasha Miller
Finance Ops, Britech Analytics
